comparison.objective: Lift a rabbit into a carrier while continuously supporting its back; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Synchronized two-arm support, level transport, lowering, and release versus fine tool/collar manipulation and guarded impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: Rabbit placed without more than 25 degrees spine bend or a 3 cm fall versus repeatable stops without force, travel, rebound, or drift violations.
comparison.reason: The record tests distributed bimanual support of an articulated load, not mechanical commissioning.
